Table read_table(string path)
    lines := read_lines(path)
    header := lines[0].split(",")
    features := header[1:<int(#header) - 1]
    Row[] rows := []
    for: 1 <= index < int(#lines)
        fields := lines[index].split(",")
        real64[] values := []
        for: 1 <= column < int(#fields) - 1
            values = values.append(decimal(fields[column]))
        rows = rows.append(Row(integer(fields[0]), values, fields[-1]))

class Params()
    prior := "empirical"
    real64 epsilon := 0.0
    real64 gamma := 0.0
    real64[] smoothing_grid := []
    real64[] gamma_grid := []
    folds := 2
    real64[] calibration_edges := []
    real64[] reject_thresholds := []
    int[] curve := []
    real64 theta := 0.0
    bootstrap_count := 1
    seed := 1
    map_size := [2, 2]
    plot_size := [2, 2]
    Subset[] subsets := []
    int[][] pairs := []

Params read_params(string[] features)
    params := Params()
    for line := read_lines("input/params.txt")[]
        words := line.split(" ")
        keyword := words[0]
        args := words[1:<int(#words)]
        if keyword == "PRIOR"
            params.prior = args[0]
        elif keyword == "SUBSET"
            int[] indices := []
            for: 1 <= index < int(#args)
                indices = indices.append(find_name(features, args[index]))
            params.subsets = params.subsets.append(Subset(args[0], indices))
        elif keyword == "PAIR"
            params.pairs = params.pairs.append([find_name(features, args[0]), find_name(features, args[1])])
        elif keyword == "VAR_SMOOTHING"
            params.epsilon = decimal(args[0])
        elif keyword == "QDA_GAMMA"
            params.gamma = decimal(args[0])
        elif keyword == "SMOOTHING_GRID"
            params.smoothing_grid = [for word := args[] then decimal(word)]
        elif keyword == "GAMMA_GRID"
            params.gamma_grid = [for word := args[] then decimal(word)]
        elif keyword == "CV_FOLDS"
            params.folds = integer(args[0])
        elif keyword == "CALIBRATION_EDGES"
            params.calibration_edges = [for word := args[] then decimal(word)]
        elif keyword == "REJECT_THRESHOLDS"
            params.reject_thresholds = [for word := args[] then decimal(word)]
        elif keyword == "CURVE"
            params.curve = [for word := args[] then integer(word)]
        elif keyword == "OUTLIER_THRESHOLD"
            params.theta = decimal(args[0])
        elif keyword == "BOOTSTRAP"
            params.bootstrap_count = integer(args[0])
            params.seed = integer(args[1])
        elif keyword == "MAP_SIZE"
            params.map_size = [integer(args[0]), integer(args[1])]
        elif keyword == "PLOT_SIZE"
            params.plot_size = [integer(args[0]), integer(args[1])]
    return params

class Dataset(string[] features, string[] classes, Row[] train, Row[] testing, real64[][] costs, Params[] parameters)

Dataset read_inputs()
    training := read_table("input/train.csv")
    testing := read_table("input/test.csv")
    string[] classes := []
    for row := training.rows[]
        if find_name(classes, row.label) < 0
            classes = classes.append(row.label)
    classes = classes.sorted()
    train := training.rows
    test_rows := testing.rows
    for: index < int(#train)
        train[index].class_index = find_name(classes, train[index].label)
    for: index < int(#test_rows)
        test_rows[index].class_index = find_name(classes, test_rows[index].label)
    real64[][] costs := array(#classes, fill = array(#classes, fill = 0.0))
    lines := read_lines("input/costs.csv")
    columns := lines[0].split(",")
    for: 1 <= index < int(#lines)
        fields := lines[index].split(",")
        actual := find_name(classes, fields[0])
        for: 1 <= column < int(#fields)
            costs[actual][find_name(classes, columns[column])] = decimal(fields[column])
    params := read_params(training.features)
    return Dataset(training.features, classes, train, test_rows, costs, [params])

import algebra = "./linalg.qui"

int[] fraction(int numerator, int denominator)
    if denominator == 0
        return []
    first := if numerator < 0 then -numerator else numerator
    second := denominator
    while second != 0
        first, second = second, first % second
    return [numerator / first, denominator / first]

int[] sum_fractions(int[][] values)
    result := [0, 1]
    for value := values[]
        result = fraction(result[0] * value[1] + value[0] * result[1], result[1] * value[1])
    return result

class Measures(int[][] matrix, int[] support, int correct, int[] accuracy, int[] balanced_accuracy, int[] kappa, int[][] recall, int[][] precision, int[][] f1, real64 macro_f1)

Measures measures(int[] actual, int[] predicted, int count)
    int[][] matrix := array(nat(count), fill = array(nat(count), fill = 0))
    for: index < int(#actual)
        matrix[actual[index]][predicted[index]] += 1
    support := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    columns := support
    correct := 0
    for: first < count
        for: second < count
            support[first] += matrix[first][second]
            columns[second] += matrix[first][second]
        correct += matrix[first][first]
    int[][] recall := []
    int[][] precision := []
    int[][] f1 := []
    expected := 0
    real64 macro_f1 := 0.0
    for: index < count
        recall = recall.append(fraction(matrix[index][index], support[index]))
        precision = precision.append(fraction(matrix[index][index], columns[index]))
        f1 = f1.append(fraction(2 * matrix[index][index], support[index] + columns[index]))
        expected += support[index] * columns[index]
        macro_f1 += algebra.as_real(2 * matrix[index][index]) / algebra.as_real(support[index] + columns[index])
    total := sum_fractions(recall)
    amount := int(#actual)
    return Measures(matrix, support, correct, fraction(correct, amount), fraction(total[0], total[1] * count), fraction(amount * correct - expected, amount * amount - expected), recall, precision, f1, macro_f1 / algebra.as_real(count))

class McNemar(int b01, int b10, real64 chi, bool significant)

McNemar mcnemar(int[] actual, int[] first, int[] second)
    b01 := 0
    b10 := 0
    for: index < int(#actual)
        if first[index] == actual[index] and second[index] != actual[index]
            b01 += 1
        elif first[index] != actual[index] and second[index] == actual[index]
            b10 += 1
    real64 chi := 0.0
    if b01 != b10
        difference := (if b01 > b10 then b01 - b10 else b10 - b01) - 1
        chi = algebra.as_real(difference * difference) / algebra.as_real(b01 + b10)
    return McNemar(b01, b10, chi, chi > 3.841)

class Statistics(int row_count, int[] counts, real64[][] means, real64[][][] scatter, real64[] center, real64[] variances, real64[][] pooled)

Statistics statistics(dataset.Row[] rows, int[] features, int count)
    size := int(#features)
    real64[][][] groups := array(nat(count), fill = [])
    real64[][] vectors := []
    for row := rows[]
        real64[] vector := []
        for feature := features[]
            vector = vector.append(row.values[feature])
        vectors = vectors.append(vector)
        groups[row.class_index] = groups[row.class_index].append(vector)
    int[] counts := []
    real64[][] means := []
    real64[][][] scatter := []
    for: category < count
        group := groups[category]
        counts = counts.append(int(#group))
        real64[] mean := []
        for: feature < size
            real64 total := 0.0
            for vector := group[]
                total += vector[feature]
            mean = mean.append(total / algebra.as_real(int(#group)))
        means = means.append(mean)
        matrix := algebra.zeros(size)
        for: first < size
            for: second < size
                real64 total := 0.0
                for vector := group[]
                    total += (vector[first] - mean[first]) * (vector[second] - mean[second])
                matrix[first][second] = total
        scatter = scatter.append(matrix)
    real64[] center := []
    real64[] variances := []
    for: feature < size
        real64 total := 0.0
        for vector := vectors[]
            total += vector[feature]
        average := total / algebra.as_real(int(#rows))
        center = center.append(average)
        total = 0.0
        for vector := vectors[]
            delta := vector[feature] - average
            total += delta * delta
        variances = variances.append(total / algebra.as_real(int(#rows)))
    pooled := algebra.zeros(size)
    for: first < size
        for: second < size
            real64 total := 0.0
            for: category < count
                total += scatter[category][first][second]
            pooled[first][second] = total / algebra.as_real(int(#rows) - count)
    return Statistics(int(#rows), counts, means, scatter, center, variances, pooled)

class Prediction(int predicted, real64[] posterior, real64[] log_posterior, real64 confidence, int decision)

class Model(string name, int[] features, Statistics[] records, string prior_mode, real64 epsilon, real64 gamma)
    real64[][] means := records[0].means
    real64[] priors := []
    real64[] log_priors := []
    real64[][][] covariances := []
    real64[][][] factors := []
    real64[] log_determinants := []
    max_variance := records[0].variances[argmax(records[0].variances)]
    added_variance := epsilon * max_variance
    normalizer := algebra.as_real(int(#features)) * algebra.logarithm(2.0 * 3.141592653589793) / 2.0
    local stats := records[0]
    local count := int(#stats.counts)
    local size := int(#features)
    for: category < count
        prior := if prior_mode == "empirical" then algebra.as_real(stats.counts[category]) / algebra.as_real(stats.row_count) else 1.0 / algebra.as_real(count)
        priors = priors.append(prior)
        log_priors = log_priors.append(algebra.logarithm(prior))
        covariance := algebra.zeros(size)
        for: first < size
            for: second < size
                if name == "LDA"
                    covariance[first][second] = stats.pooled[first][second]
                elif name == "NB"
                    if first == second
                        covariance[first][second] = stats.scatter[category][first][second] / algebra.as_real(stats.counts[category]) + added_variance
                else
                    value := stats.scatter[category][first][second] / algebra.as_real(stats.counts[category] - 1)
                    covariance[first][second] = if first == second then value else value * (1.0 - gamma)
        covariances = covariances.append(covariance)
        factor := algebra.cholesky(covariance)
        factors = factors.append(factor)
        log_determinants = log_determinants.append(algebra.log_determinant(factor))

    real64[] vector(real64[] values)
        real64[] result := []
        for feature := features[]
            result = result.append(values[feature])
        return result

    real64[] squared_distances(real64[] point)
        real64[] result := []
        for: category < int(#means)
            real64[] delta := []
            for: feature < int(#point)
                delta = delta.append(point[feature] - means[category][feature])
            result = result.append(algebra.quadratic(factors[category], delta))
        return result

    real64[] distances(real64[] values)
        return squared_distances(vector(values))

    real64[] scores(real64[] point)
        distances_squared := squared_distances(point)
        real64[] result := []
        for: category < int(#means)
            result = result.append(log_priors[category] - normalizer - log_determinants[category] / 2.0 - distances_squared[category] / 2.0)
        return result

    int predict(real64[] values)
        return argmax(scores(vector(values)))

    Prediction infer_vector(real64[] point, real64[][] costs := [])
        discriminants := scores(point)
        predicted := argmax(discriminants)
        maximum := discriminants[predicted]
        real64[] exponentials := []
        real64 total := 0.0
        for score := discriminants[]
            value := algebra.exponential(score - maximum)
            exponentials = exponentials.append(value)
            total += value
        log_total := algebra.logarithm(total)
        real64[] posterior := []
        real64[] log_posterior := []
        for: category < int(#means)
            posterior = posterior.append(exponentials[category] / total)
            log_posterior = log_posterior.append((discriminants[category] - maximum) - log_total)
        decision := predicted
        if #costs > 0
            real64[] risks := []
            for: decided < int(#means)
                real64 risk := 0.0
                for: category < int(#means)
                    risk += posterior[category] * costs[category][decided]
                risks = risks.append(risk)
            decision = argmin(risks)
        return Prediction(predicted, posterior, log_posterior, posterior[argmax(posterior)], decision)

    Prediction infer(real64[] values, real64[][] costs := [])
        return infer_vector(vector(values), costs)

Model train(dataset.Row[] rows, int[] features, int count, string name, string prior_mode, real64 epsilon, real64 gamma)
    stats := statistics(rows, features, count)
    return Model(name, features, [stats], prior_mode, epsilon, gamma)

import math

real64 as_real(int value)
    result := real64(value)
    return result

real64 square_root(real64 value)
    result := math.sqrt(value)
    return result

real64 logarithm(real64 value)
    result := math.log(value)
    return result

real64 exponential(real64 value)
    result := math.exp(value)
    return result

real64[][] zeros(int size)
    return array(nat(size), fill = array(nat(size), fill = 0.0))

real64 dot(real64[] first, real64[] second)
    real64 result := 0.0
    for: index < int(#first)
        result += first[index] * second[index]
    return result

real64[][] cholesky(real64[][] matrix)
    size := int(#matrix)
    lower := zeros(size)
    for: row < size
        for: column <= row
            real64 subtotal := 0.0
            for: index < column
                subtotal += lower[row][index] * lower[column][index]
            remainder := matrix[row][column] - subtotal
            lower[row][column] = if row == column then square_root(remainder) else remainder / lower[column][column]
    return lower

real64[] forward(real64[][] lower, real64[] right)
    real64[] result := array(#lower, fill = 0.0)
    for: row < int(#lower)
        real64 subtotal := 0.0
        for: index < row
            subtotal += lower[row][index] * result[index]
        result[row] = (right[row] - subtotal) / lower[row][row]
    return result

real64[] backward(real64[][] lower, real64[] right)
    size := int(#lower)
    real64[] result := array(nat(size), fill = 0.0)
    for: size - 1 >= row >= 0
        real64 subtotal := 0.0
        for: row + 1 <= index < size
            subtotal += lower[index][row] * result[index]
        result[row] = (right[row] - subtotal) / lower[row][row]
    return result

real64 log_determinant(real64[][] lower)
    real64 total := 0.0
    for: index < int(#lower)
        total += logarithm(lower[index][index])
    return 2.0 * total

real64 quadratic(real64[][] lower, real64[] difference)
    transformed := forward(lower, difference)
    return dot(transformed, transformed)

class Eigen(real64[] values, real64[][] vectors, int sweeps)

Eigen jacobi(real64[][] matrix)
    size := int(#matrix)
    current := matrix
    vectors := zeros(size)
    for: index < size
        vectors[index][index] = 1.0
    sweeps := 0
    while true
        real64 off := 0.0
        for: first < size - 1
            for: first + 1 <= second < size
                off += current[first][second] * current[first][second]
        if square_root(off) < 0.000000000001 or sweeps == 50
            break
        for: first < size - 1
            for: first + 1 <= second < size
                if current[first][second] == 0.0
                    continue
                theta := (current[second][second] - current[first][first]) / (2.0 * current[first][second])
                real64 sign := if theta >= 0.0 then 1.0 else -1.0
                magnitude := if theta < 0.0 then -theta else theta
                tangent := sign / (magnitude + square_root(theta * theta + 1.0))
                cosine := 1.0 / square_root(tangent * tangent + 1.0)
                sine := tangent * cosine
                for: index < size
                    if index != first and index != second
                        horizontal := current[index][first]
                        vertical := current[index][second]
                        current[index][first] = cosine * horizontal - sine * vertical
                        current[first][index] = current[index][first]
                        current[index][second] = sine * horizontal + cosine * vertical
                        current[second][index] = current[index][second]
                value := current[first][second]
                current[first][first] -= tangent * value
                current[second][second] += tangent * value
                current[first][second] = 0.0
                current[second][first] = 0.0
                for: index < size
                    horizontal := vectors[index][first]
                    vertical := vectors[index][second]
                    vectors[index][first] = cosine * horizontal - sine * vertical
                    vectors[index][second] = sine * horizontal + cosine * vertical
        sweeps += 1
    real64[] values := []
    for: index < size
        values = values.append(current[index][index])
    return Eigen(values, vectors, sweeps)

class CrossValidation(string name, int[] features, real64 epsilon, real64 gamma, int[] predictions, int[] fold_correct, int correct)
class RankedRow(real64 distance, int index, nearest := -1)

RankedRow[] ranked_rows(RankedRow[] rows)
    RankedRow[] result := []
    for row := rows[]
        place := int(#result)
        result = result.append(row)
        while place > 0 and (row.distance > result[place - 1].distance or (row.distance == result[place - 1].distance and row.index < result[place - 1].index))
            result[place] = result[place - 1]
            place -= 1
        result[place] = row
    return result

class Analysis(models.dataset.Dataset[] inputs)
    string[] features := inputs[0].features
    string[] classes := inputs[0].classes
    models.dataset.Row[] training := inputs[0].train
    models.dataset.Row[] testing := inputs[0].testing
    models.dataset.Params[] parameters := inputs[0].parameters
    real64[][] costs := inputs[0].costs
    n := int(#training)
    m := int(#testing)
    d := int(#features)
    class_count := int(#classes)
    all_features := 0:<d
    int[] train_actual := [for row := training[] then row.class_index]
    int[] test_actual := [for row := testing[] then row.class_index]
    string[] upper := []
    string[] lower := []
    int[] folds := []
    fold_sizes := array(nat(parameters[0].folds), fill = 0)
    models.Model[] main_models := []
    models.Prediction[][] results := []
    int[][] main_predictions := []
    CrossValidation[] cache := []
    for name := classes[]
        lower = lower.append(name[0])
        int letter := name.codepoints()[0] - 97
        upper = upper.append("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"[letter])
    for row := training[]
        int fold := row.id % parameters[0].folds
        folds = folds.append(fold)
        fold_sizes[fold] += 1
    for name := model_names()[]
        models.Model fitted := fit(name)
        main_models = main_models.append(fitted)
        models.Prediction[] inferred := []
        int[] predicted := []
        for row := testing[]
            result := fitted.infer(row.values, costs)
            inferred = inferred.append(result)
            predicted = predicted.append(result.predicted)
        results = results.append(inferred)
        main_predictions = main_predictions.append(predicted)

    string feature_names(int[] sequence)
        string[] result := []
        for feature := sequence[]
            result = result.append(features[feature])
        return result.join(" ")

    models.Model fit(string name, int[] feature_sequence := [], models.dataset.Row[] row_sequence := [], prior_mode := "", real64 epsilon := -1.0, real64 gamma := -1.0)
        settings := parameters[0]
        return models.train(if #row_sequence == 0 then training else row_sequence, if #feature_sequence == 0 then all_features else feature_sequence, class_count, name, if prior_mode == "" then settings.prior else prior_mode, if epsilon < 0.0 then settings.epsilon else epsilon, if gamma < 0.0 then settings.gamma else gamma)

    CrossValidation .cross_validate(string name, int[] sequence, real64 epsilon := -1.0, real64 gamma := -1.0)
        settings := parameters[0]
        if epsilon < 0.0
            epsilon = settings.epsilon
        if gamma < 0.0
            gamma = settings.gamma
        for record := cache[]
            if record.name == name and record.features == sequence and record.epsilon == epsilon and record.gamma == gamma
                return record
        predicted := array(nat(n), fill = 0)
        int[] fold_correct := []
        total := 0
        for: int fold < settings.folds
            models.dataset.Row[] retained := []
            for: index < n
                if folds[index] != fold
                    retained = retained.append(training[index])
            models.Model fitted := fit(name, sequence, retained, epsilon = epsilon, gamma = gamma)
            correct := 0
            for: index < n
                if folds[index] == fold
                    predicted[index] = fitted.predict(training[index].values)
                    if predicted[index] == train_actual[index]
                        correct += 1
            fold_correct = fold_correct.append(correct)
            total += correct
        result := CrossValidation(name, sequence, epsilon, gamma, predicted, fold_correct, total)
        cache = cache.append(result)
        return result

    string[][] model_sections()
        settings := parameters[0]
        nb := main_models[0]
        lda := main_models[1]
        qda := main_models[2]
        models.Statistics stats := nb.records[0]
        string[][] sections := []
        string[] lines := ["features " + features.join(" "), "classes " + classes.join(" "), "prior_mode " + settings.prior]
        for: category < class_count
            lines = lines.append("class " + classes[category] + " letter " + upper[category] + " count {stats.counts[category]} prior " + plot.real_text(nb.priors[category]) + " mean " + plot.reals(stats.means[category]))
        sections = sections.append(lines)
        lines = ["model NB", "smoothing epsilon " + plot.real_text(nb.epsilon) + " max_variance " + plot.real_text(nb.max_variance) + " added " + plot.real_text(nb.added_variance)]
        for: category < class_count
            real64[] diagonal := []
            for: feature < d
                diagonal = diagonal.append(nb.covariances[category][feature][feature])
            lines = lines.append("class " + classes[category] + " variance " + plot.reals(diagonal) + " log_det " + plot.real_text(nb.log_determinants[category]))
        sections = sections.append(lines)
        factor := lda.factors[0]
        lines = ["model LDA", "log_det " + plot.real_text(lda.log_determinants[0])]
        for row := lda.covariances[0][]
            lines = lines.append("  " + plot.reals(row))
        for: category < class_count
            coefficients := algebra.backward(factor, algebra.forward(factor, lda.means[category]))
            intercept := algebra.logarithm(lda.priors[category]) - algebra.dot(lda.means[category], coefficients) / 2.0
            lines = lines.append("class " + classes[category] + " intercept " + plot.real_text(intercept) + " coef " + plot.reals(coefficients))
        sections = sections.append(lines)
        lines = ["model QDA gamma " + plot.real_text(qda.gamma)]
        for: category < class_count
            decomposed := algebra.jacobi(qda.covariances[category])
            eigenvalues := decomposed.values.sorted(descending = true)
            condition := eigenvalues[0] / eigenvalues[-1]
            lines = lines.append("class " + classes[category] + " log_det " + plot.real_text(qda.log_determinants[category]) + " eigenvalues " + plot.reals(eigenvalues) + " condition " + plot.real_text(condition))
            for row := qda.covariances[category][]
                lines = lines.append("  " + plot.reals(row))
        sections = sections.append(lines)
        lines = ["separation"]
        for: first < class_count - 1
            for: first + 1 <= second < class_count
                delta := difference(stats.means[first], stats.means[second])
                mahalanobis := algebra.square_root(algebra.quadratic(factor, delta))
                average := algebra.zeros(d)
                for: row < d
                    for: column < d
                        average[row][column] = (qda.covariances[first][row][column] + qda.covariances[second][row][column]) / 2.0
                average_factor := algebra.cholesky(average)
                bhattacharyya := algebra.quadratic(average_factor, delta) / 8.0 + (algebra.log_determinant(average_factor) - (qda.log_determinants[first] + qda.log_determinants[second]) / 2.0) / 2.0
                lines = lines.append(classes[first] + " " + classes[second] + " mahalanobis " + plot.real_text(mahalanobis) + " bhattacharyya " + plot.real_text(bhattacharyya))
        sections = sections.append(lines)
        RankedRow[] outliers := []
        for: index < n
            row := training[index]
            distances := qda.distances(row.values)
            distance := distances[row.class_index]
            if distance > settings.theta
                outliers = outliers.append(RankedRow(distance, index))
        lines = ["outliers threshold " + plot.real_text(settings.theta)]
        for outlier := ranked_rows(outliers)[]
            row := training[outlier.index]
            lines = lines.append("{row.id} {row.label} q " + plot.real_text(outlier.distance))
        lines = lines.append("count {#outliers}")
        return sections.append(lines)

    string[] prediction_lines()
        lines := ["id,model,actual,predicted,decision," + classes.join(",")]
        names := model_names()
        for: index < m
            row := testing[index]
            for: model < 3
                result := results[model][index]
                string[] fields := ["{row.id}", names[model], row.label, classes[result.predicted], classes[result.decision]]
                for probability := result.posterior[]
                    fields = fields.append(plot.real_text(probability))
                lines = lines.append(fields.join(","))
        return lines

    string[] model_evaluation(int model_index)
        settings := parameters[0]
        inferred := results[model_index]
        metrics := evaluation.measures(test_actual, main_predictions[model_index], class_count)
        names := model_names()
        lines := ["model " + names[model_index]]
        lines = lines.concat(confusion_lines(classes, metrics.matrix))
        lines = lines.concat(["accuracy " + plot.fraction_text(metrics.accuracy), "balanced_accuracy " + plot.fraction_text(metrics.balanced_accuracy), "kappa " + plot.fraction_text(metrics.kappa)])
        for: category < class_count
            lines = lines.append("class " + classes[category] + " support {metrics.support[category]} recall " + plot.fraction_text(metrics.recall[category]) + " precision " + plot.fraction_text(metrics.precision[category]) + " f1 " + plot.fraction_text(metrics.f1[category]))
        real64 loss := 0.0
        string[] errors := []
        for: index < m
            row := testing[index]
            result := inferred[index]
            loss += result.log_posterior[row.class_index]
            if result.predicted != row.class_index
                errors = errors.append("error {row.id} actual {row.label} predicted " + classes[result.predicted] + " confidence " + plot.real_text(result.confidence))
        lines = lines.concat(["macro_f1 " + plot.real_text(metrics.macro_f1), "log_loss " + plot.real_text(-loss / algebra.as_real(m)), "errors {#errors}"]).concat(errors)
        real64[] edges := [0.0]
        edges = edges.concat(settings.calibration_edges).append(1.0)
        real64 calibration_error := 0.0
        for: bin_index < int(#edges) - 1
            low := edges[bin_index]
            high := edges[bin_index + 1]
            count := 0
            correct := 0
            real64 confidence := 0.0
            for: index < m
                result := inferred[index]
                if result.confidence >= low and (result.confidence < high or (bin_index == int(#edges) - 2 and result.confidence == high))
                    count += 1
                    confidence += result.confidence
                    if result.predicted == test_actual[index]
                        correct += 1
            average := if count > 0 then plot.real_text(confidence / algebra.as_real(count)) else "-"
            lines = lines.append("bin " + plot.real_text(low) + " " + plot.real_text(high) + " count {count} confidence {average} accuracy " + plot.ratio(correct, count))
            discrepancy := algebra.as_real(correct) - confidence
            calibration_error += if discrepancy < 0.0 then -discrepancy else discrepancy
        lines = lines.append("ece " + plot.real_text(calibration_error / algebra.as_real(m)))
        for threshold := settings.reject_thresholds[]
            count := 0
            correct := 0
            for: index < m
                if inferred[index].confidence >= threshold
                    count += 1
                    if inferred[index].predicted == test_actual[index]
                        correct += 1
            lines = lines.append("reject " + plot.real_text(threshold) + " accepted {count} coverage " + plot.ratio(count, m) + " accuracy " + plot.ratio(correct, count))
        return lines

    string[] bootstrap_lines()
        settings := parameters[0]
        generator := evaluation.Generator(settings.seed)
        int count := settings.bootstrap_count
        int[][] resamples := [[], [], []]
        for _ < count
            correct := [0, 0, 0]
            for _ < m
                value := .generator.draw()
                index := value % m
                for: model < 3
                    if main_predictions[model][index] == test_actual[index]
                        correct[model] += 1
            for: model < 3
                resamples[model] = resamples[model].append(correct[model])
        lines := ["bootstrap resamples {count} seed {settings.seed}"]
        names := model_names()
        offset := count / 40
        for: model < 3
            ordered := resamples[model].sorted()
            total := 0
            for value := ordered[]
                total += value
            mean := algebra.as_real(total) / algebra.as_real(count) / algebra.as_real(m)
            lines = lines.append(names[model] + " mean " + plot.real_text(mean) + " interval " + plot.ratio(ordered[offset], m) + " " + plot.ratio(ordered[count - offset - 1], m))
        for: first < 2
            for: first + 1 <= second < 3
                wins := 0
                ties := 0
                for: index < count
                    if resamples[first][index] > resamples[second][index]
                        wins += 1
                    elif resamples[first][index] == resamples[second][index]
                        ties += 1
                lines = lines.append(names[first] + " " + names[second] + " wins {wins} ties {ties} losses {count - wins - ties}")
        return lines

    string[] .subset_lines()
        settings := parameters[0]
        lines := ["cross_validation folds {settings.folds}", "fold_sizes " + integers(fold_sizes)]
        best_subset := -1
        best_model := -1
        best_correct := -1
        best_size := d + 1

                size := int(#subset.features)
                if result.correct > best_correct or (result.correct == best_correct and size < best_size)
                    best_subset = subset_index
                    best_model = model
                    best_correct = result.correct
                    best_size = size
        models.dataset.Subset selected := settings.subsets[best_subset]
        lines = lines.append("best subset {selected.name} model " + names[best_model] + " correct {best_correct} accuracy " + plot.ratio(best_correct, n))

    string[][] .forward_sections()
        string[][] sections := []
        for name := model_names()[]
            lines := ["forward_selection model {name}"]
            int[] selected := []
            chosen := array(nat(d), fill = false)
            best_step := 0
            best_correct := -1
            for: 1 <= step <= d
                added := -1
                step_correct := -1
                for: feature < d
                    if not chosen[feature]
                        CrossValidation result := .cross_validate(name, selected.append(feature))
                        if result.correct > step_correct
                            added = feature
                            step_correct = result.correct
                selected = selected.append(added)
                chosen[added] = true
                lines = lines.append("step {step} add " + features[added] + " correct {step_correct} accuracy " + plot.ratio(step_correct, n))
                if step_correct > best_correct
                    best_step = step
                    best_correct = step_correct
            lines = lines.append("best_step {best_step} features " + feature_names(selected[0:<best_step]))
            sections = sections.append(lines)
        return sections

    string[] .tuning_lines(string name, real64[] values, string title)
        lines := [title]
        real64 best_value := 0.0
        best_correct := -1
        for value := values[]
            CrossValidation result := .cross_validate(name, all_features, epsilon = if name == "NB" then value else -1.0, gamma = if name == "QDA" then value else -1.0)
            lines = lines.append("value " + plot.real_text(value) + " correct {result.correct} accuracy " + plot.ratio(result.correct, n))
            if result.correct >= best_correct
                best_value = value
                best_correct = result.correct
        models.Model fitted := fit(name, epsilon = if name == "NB" then best_value else -1.0, gamma = if name == "QDA" then best_value else -1.0)
        correct := correct_count(test_actual, row_predictions(fitted, testing))
        return lines.append("best " + plot.real_text(best_value) + " test correct {correct} accuracy " + plot.ratio(correct, m))

    string[][] .evaluation_sections()
        settings := parameters[0]
        string[][] sections := [["test rows {m}"]]
        names := model_names()
        for: index < 3
            sections = sections.append(model_evaluation(index))
        int[] ensemble := []
        for: index < m
            real64[] posterior := []
            for: category < class_count
                real64 total := 0.0
                for: model < 3
                    total += results[model][index].posterior[category]
                posterior = posterior.append(total / 3.0)
            ensemble = ensemble.append(models.argmax(posterior))
        metrics := evaluation.measures(test_actual, ensemble, class_count)
        sections = sections.append(["ensemble soft_vote", "accuracy " + plot.fraction_text(metrics.accuracy) + " balanced_accuracy " + plot.fraction_text(metrics.balanced_accuracy) + " kappa " + plot.fraction_text(metrics.kappa)])
        compared_predictions := main_predictions.append(ensemble)
        sections = sections.append(comparisons("mcnemar test", names.append("ENSEMBLE"), compared_predictions, test_actual))
        lines := ["costs"]
        for: model < 3
            real64 argmax_total := 0.0
            real64 decision_total := 0.0
            changed := 0
            correct := 0
            for: index < m
                result := results[model][index]
                argmax_total += costs[test_actual[index]][result.predicted]
                decision_total += costs[test_actual[index]][result.decision]
                if result.predicted != result.decision
                    changed += 1
                if result.decision == test_actual[index]
                    correct += 1
            lines = lines.append(names[model] + " argmax_total " + plot.real_text(argmax_total) + " decision_total " + plot.real_text(decision_total) + " changed {changed} decision_accuracy " + plot.ratio(correct, m))
        sections = sections.append(lines)
        qda := main_models[2]
        RankedRow[] novel := []
        for: index < m
            distances := qda.distances(testing[index].values)
            nearest := models.argmin(distances)
            if distances[nearest] > settings.theta
                novel = novel.append(RankedRow(distances[nearest], index, nearest))
        lines = ["novelty threshold " + plot.real_text(settings.theta)]
        for row := ranked_rows(novel)[]
            lines = lines.append("{testing[row.index].id} nearest " + classes[row.nearest] + " q " + plot.real_text(row.distance))
        sections = sections.append(lines.append("count {#novel}"))
        sections = sections.append(bootstrap_lines())
        alternative := if settings.prior == "empirical" then "uniform" else "empirical"
        lines = ["prior_sensitivity alternative {alternative}"]
        for: model < 3
            models.Model fitted := fit(names[model], prior_mode = alternative)
            predicted := row_predictions(fitted, testing)

            for: index < m

            lines = lines.append(names[model] + " accuracy " + plot.fraction_text(measures.accuracy) + " balanced_accuracy " + plot.fraction_text(measures.balanced_accuracy) + " changed {changed}")
        sections = sections.append(lines)
        lines = ["learning_curve"]
        for size := settings.curve[]
            models.dataset.Row[] retained := []
            taken := array(nat(class_count), fill = 0)
            for row := training[]
                if taken[row.class_index] < size
                    retained = retained.append(row)
                    taken[row.class_index] += 1
            line := "size {size} rows {#retained}"
            for name := names[]
                models.Model fitted := fit(name, row_sequence = retained)
                line += " {name} " + plot.ratio(correct_count(test_actual, row_predictions(fitted, testing)), m)
            lines = lines.append(line)
        sections = sections.append(lines)
        sections = sections.append(.subset_lines())
        int[][] cv_predictions := []
        for name := names[]
            CrossValidation result := .cross_validate(name, all_features)
            cv_predictions = cv_predictions.append(result.predictions)
        sections = sections.append(comparisons("mcnemar cross_validation", names, cv_predictions, train_actual))
        for: model < 3
            measures := evaluation.measures(train_actual, cv_predictions[model], class_count)
            confusion := ["cv_confusion model " + names[model]]
            confusion = confusion.concat(confusion_lines(classes, measures.matrix))
            confusion = confusion.append("balanced_accuracy " + plot.fraction_text(measures.balanced_accuracy) + " kappa " + plot.fraction_text(measures.kappa))
            sections = sections.append(confusion)
        lines = ["leave_one_out"]
        for name := names[]
            correct := 0
            for: excluded < n

                models.Model fitted := fit(name, row_sequence = retained)
                if fitted.predict(training[excluded].values) == train_actual[excluded]
                    correct += 1
            lines = lines.append("{name} correct {correct} accuracy " + plot.ratio(correct, n))
        sections = sections.append(lines).concat(.forward_sections())
        sections = sections.append(.tuning_lines("NB", settings.smoothing_grid, "nb_smoothing_path"))
        return sections.append(.tuning_lines("QDA", settings.gamma_grid, "qda_gamma_path"))

    real64[] limits_of(real64[][] points)
        xmin := points[0][0]
        xmax := xmin
        ymin := points[0][1]
        ymax := ymin
        for point := points[]
            if point[0] < xmin
                xmin = point[0]
            if point[0] > xmax
                xmax = point[0]
            if point[1] < ymin
                ymin = point[1]
            if point[1] > ymax
                ymax = point[1]
        return [xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax]

    string[][] point_grid(real64[][] points, int[] actual, real64[] limits, int[] size)
        width := size[0]
        height := size[1]
        string[][] grid := array(nat(height), fill = array(nat(width), fill = " "))
        for: index < int(#points)
            column := plot.cell(points[index][0], limits[0], limits[1], width)
            row := height - 1 - plot.cell(points[index][1], limits[2], limits[3], height)
            letter := lower[actual[index]]
            previous := grid[row][column]
            grid[row][column] = if previous == " " or previous == letter then letter else "*"
        return grid

    string[][] .boundary_sections()
        settings := parameters[0]
        int width := settings.map_size[0]
        int height := settings.map_size[1]
        string[][] sections := []
        for pair := settings.pairs[]
            real64[][] points := []
            for row := training[]
                points = points.append([row.values[pair[0]], row.values[pair[1]]])
            real64[] limits := limits_of(points)
            xmin := limits[0]
            xmax := limits[1]
            ymin := limits[2]
            ymax := limits[3]
            dx := (xmax - xmin) / algebra.as_real(width - 1)
            dy := (ymax - ymin) / algebra.as_real(height - 1)
            lines := [
                "pair " + features[pair[0]] + " " + features[pair[1]],
                "x " + features[pair[0]] + " " + plot.real_text(xmin) + " " + plot.real_text(xmax) + " y " + features[pair[1]] + " " + plot.real_text(ymin) + " " + plot.real_text(ymax) + " grid {width}x{height}",
            ]
            models.Prediction[][][] grids := []
            for name := model_names()[]
                models.Model fitted := fit(name, pair)
                correct := correct_count(train_actual, row_predictions(fitted, training))
                CrossValidation cv := .cross_validate(name, pair)
                lines = lines.append("model {name} train_accuracy " + plot.ratio(correct, n) + " cv_accuracy " + plot.ratio(cv.correct, n))
                string[][] grid := []
                models.Prediction[][] inferred := []
                counts := array(nat(class_count), fill = 0)
                for: row < height
                    string[] cells := []
                    models.Prediction[] predictions := []
                    for: column < width
                        point := [xmin + algebra.as_real(column) * dx, ymax - algebra.as_real(row) * dy]
                        result := fitted.infer_vector(point)
                        predictions = predictions.append(result)
                        cells = cells.append(upper[result.predicted])
                        counts[result.predicted] += 1
                    grid = grid.append(cells)
                    inferred = inferred.append(predictions)
                grids = grids.append(inferred)
                lines = lines.concat(plot.frame(grid))
                line := "cells"
                for: category < class_count
                    line += " " + upper[category] + " {counts[category]}"
                lines = lines.append(line)
            string[][] agreement := []
            string[][] uncertainty := []
            disagreements := 0
            level_characters := " .:-=+*#%@"
            for: row < height
                string[] agreement_row := []
                string[] uncertainty_row := []
                for: column < width
                    seen := array(nat(class_count), fill = false)
                    distinct_count := 0
                    for: model < 3
                        predicted := grids[model][row][column].predicted
                        if not seen[predicted]
                            seen[predicted] = true
                            distinct_count += 1
                    agreement_row = agreement_row.append(if distinct_count == 1 then "." else "{distinct_count}")
                    if distinct_count != 1
                        disagreements += 1
                    value := (1.0 - grids[2][row][column].confidence) / (1.0 - 1.0 / algebra.as_real(class_count))
                    scaled := 10.0 * value
                    level := floor_value(scaled)
                    if level > 9
                        level = 9
                    uncertainty_row = uncertainty_row.append(level_characters[level])
                agreement = agreement.append(agreement_row)
                uncertainty = uncertainty.append(uncertainty_row)
            lines = lines.append("agreement").concat(plot.frame(agreement))
            lines = lines.concat(["disagreement_cells {disagreements}", "uncertainty QDA"]).concat(plot.frame(uncertainty))
            lines = lines.append("points").concat(plot.frame(point_grid(points, train_actual, limits, settings.map_size)))
            sections = sections.append(lines)
        return sections

    int nearest_correct(real64[][] points, int[] actual, real64[][] centroids, int dimensions)
        correct := 0
        for: index < int(#points)
            real64[] distances := []
            for centroid := centroids[]
                delta := points[index][0] - centroid[0]
                distance := delta * delta
                if dimensions == 2
                    delta = points[index][1] - centroid[1]
                    distance += delta * delta
                distances = distances.append(distance)
            if models.argmin(distances) == actual[index]
                correct += 1
        return correct

    real64[][] project_points(real64[][] points, real64[][] directions, real64[] center)
        real64[][] result := []
        for point := points[]
            real64[] projected := []
            for direction := directions[]
                real64 total := 0.0
                for: feature < d
                    total += direction[feature] * (point[feature] - center[feature])
                projected = projected.append(total)
            result = result.append(projected)
        return result

    string[][] projection_sections()
        settings := parameters[0]
        nb := main_models[0]
        lda := main_models[1]
        models.Statistics stats := nb.records[0]
        center := stats.center
        within := algebra.zeros(d)
        between := algebra.zeros(d)
        for: first < d
            for: second < d
                real64 sw := 0.0
                real64 sb := 0.0
                for: category < class_count
                    sw += stats.scatter[category][first][second]
                    sb += algebra.as_real(stats.counts[category]) * (stats.means[category][first] - center[first]) * (stats.means[category][second] - center[second])
                within[first][second] = sw
                between[first][second] = sb
        real64[] f_values := []
        for: feature < d
            f_values = f_values.append((between[feature][feature] / algebra.as_real(class_count - 1)) / (within[feature][feature] / algebra.as_real(n - class_count)))
        int[] feature_order := []
        for: feature < d
            place := int(#feature_order)
            feature_order = feature_order.append(feature)
            while place > 0 and f_values[feature] > f_values[feature_order[place - 1]]
                feature_order[place] = feature_order[place - 1]
                place -= 1
            feature_order[place] = feature
        univariate := ["univariate"]
        for: rank < d
            feature := feature_order[rank]
            univariate = univariate.append("rank {rank + 1} " + features[feature] + " f " + plot.real_text(f_values[feature]) + " between " + plot.real_text(between[feature][feature]) + " within " + plot.real_text(within[feature][feature]))
        factor := algebra.cholesky(within)
        transformed := algebra.zeros(d)
        for: column < d
            real64[] source := []
            for: row < d
                source = source.append(between[row][column])
            values := algebra.forward(factor, source)
            for: row < d
                transformed[row][column] = values[row]
        whitened := algebra.zeros(d)
        for: column < d
            values := algebra.forward(factor, transformed[column])
            for: row < d
                whitened[row][column] = values[row]
        symmetric := algebra.zeros(d)
        for: first < d
            for: second < d
                symmetric[first][second] = (whitened[first][second] + whitened[second][first]) / 2.0
        eigen := algebra.jacobi(symmetric)
        int[] eigen_order := []
        for: feature < d
            place := int(#eigen_order)
            eigen_order = eigen_order.append(feature)
            while place > 0 and eigen.values[feature] > eigen.values[eigen_order[place - 1]]
                eigen_order[place] = eigen_order[place - 1]
                place -= 1
            eigen_order[place] = feature
        eigen_sum := sum_values(eigen.values)
        real64[][] directions := []
        for: dimension < 2
            real64[] vector := []
            for: feature < d
                vector = vector.append(eigen.vectors[feature][eigen_order[dimension]])
            vector = algebra.backward(factor, vector)
            norm := algebra.square_root(algebra.dot(vector, vector))
            real64[] magnitudes := []
            for: feature < d
                vector[feature] /= norm
                magnitudes = magnitudes.append(if vector[feature] < 0.0 then -vector[feature] else vector[feature])
            if vector[models.argmax(magnitudes)] < 0.0
                for: feature < d
                    vector[feature] = -vector[feature]
            directions = directions.append(vector)
        real64[][] training_vectors := [for row := training[] then row.values]
        real64[][] testing_vectors := [for row := testing[] then row.values]
        real64[][] train_points := project_points(training_vectors, directions, center)
        real64[][] test_points := project_points(testing_vectors, directions, center)
        real64[][] centroids := project_points(stats.means, directions, center)
        real64[] ordered_values := []
        real64[] ratios := []
        for feature := eigen_order[]
            ordered_values = ordered_values.append(eigen.values[feature])
            ratios = ratios.append(eigen.values[feature] / eigen_sum)
        fisher := ["fisher features " + features.join(" "), "center " + plot.reals(center), "sweeps {eigen.sweeps}", "eigenvalues " + plot.reals(ordered_values), "ratios " + plot.reals(ratios)]
        pooled := lda.covariances[0]
        for: dimension < 2
            real64[] standardized := []
            for: feature < d
                standardized = standardized.append(directions[dimension][feature] * algebra.square_root(pooled[feature][feature]))
            fisher = fisher.append("direction {dimension + 1} " + plot.reals(directions[dimension]))
            fisher = fisher.append("standardized {dimension + 1} " + plot.reals(standardized))
        for: category < class_count
            real64[] spread := []
            for: dimension < 2
                real64 subtotal := 0.0
                for: index < n
                    if train_actual[index] == category
                        delta := train_points[index][dimension] - centroids[category][dimension]
                        subtotal += delta * delta
                spread = spread.append(algebra.square_root(subtotal / algebra.as_real(stats.counts[category])))
            fisher = fisher.append("centroid " + classes[category] + " " + plot.reals(centroids[category]) + " spread " + plot.reals(spread))
        for: 1 <= dimensions <= 2
            int training_correct := nearest_correct(train_points, train_actual, centroids, dimensions)
            int testing_correct := nearest_correct(test_points, test_actual, centroids, dimensions)
            fisher = fisher.append("nearest_centroid dims {dimensions} train " + plot.ratio(training_correct, n) + " test " + plot.ratio(testing_correct, m))
        real64[] limits := limits_of(train_points)
        int width := settings.plot_size[0]
        int height := settings.plot_size[1]
        string[][] grid := point_grid(train_points, train_actual, limits, settings.plot_size)
        for: category < class_count
            column := plot.cell(centroids[category][0], limits[0], limits[1], width)
            row := height - 1 - plot.cell(centroids[category][1], limits[2], limits[3], height)
            grid[row][column] = upper[category]
        scatter := ["plot x " + plot.real_text(limits[0]) + " " + plot.real_text(limits[1]) + " y " + plot.real_text(limits[2]) + " " + plot.real_text(limits[3]) + " size {width}x{height}"]
        scatter = scatter.concat(plot.frame(grid))
        return [univariate, fisher, scatter]

import math
import evaluation = "./evaluation.qui"

string real_text(real64 value)
    result := "{value:.4}"
    return if result == "-0.0000" then "0.0000" else result

string reals(real64[] values)
    fields := [for value := values[] then real_text(value)]
    return fields.join(" ")

string fraction_text(int[] value)
    if #value == 0
        return "-"
    numerator := real64(value[0])
    denominator := real64(value[1])
    return "{value[0]}/{value[1]} " + real_text(numerator / denominator)

string ratio(int numerator, int denominator)
    return fraction_text(evaluation.fraction(numerator, denominator))

int cell(real64 value, real64 low, real64 high, int size)
    scale := real64(size - 1)
    position := (value - low) / (high - low) * scale + 0.5
    result := math.floor(position)
    return result

string[] frame(string[][] grid)
    border := "+" + "-" * #grid[0] + "+"
    result := [border]
    for row := grid[]
        result = result.append("|" + row.join("") + "|")
    return result.append(border)

string[] join_sections(string[][] sections)
    string[] result := []
    for: index < int(#sections)
        if index > 0
            result = result.append("")
        result = result.concat(sections[index])
    return result

void save(string name, string[] lines)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(lines.join(NL) + NL)
